subject: [RFC PATCH 51/57] selftests/mm: cover collapse inside a sub-PMD VMA

2026-08-16.patch_summary: This patch adds two new test cases to the selftests/mm/khugepaged.c file, which cover the collapse of memory inside a sub-page map directory (PMD) VMA. The first case tests collapsing an mTHP in a VMA that holds exactly one window, while the second case tests collapsing multiple windows within a single VMA. This patch addresses a limitation in the old mechanism, where VMAs smaller than a PMD were not considered valid collapse targets, resulting in missed opportunities for memory compaction on systems with large page sizes.
